name: Ultralight Dark Smoke Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Real oak veneer in a dark smoked brown finish, laminated onto 9mm recycled acoustic felt with a black backing and no rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer specifications override photo estimates: seven 1.20 in faces on a 1.69 in pitch with 0.49 in, 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm deep, leaving 2.8 mm felt, and 0.35 in total depth; these exact face/groove sizes total 11.83 in rather than the inconsistent listed 11.80 in panel width. The tile is seven pitches wide and 23.66 in tall, with periodic procedural oak grain and dark smoked-brown veneer/black felt colors sampled from the main listing photo.
